basePrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE production expression-pair sprite for a children's educational game. Reference 1 is the APPROVED STYLE and design sheet: match its faces, proportions, thin dark navy outline, soft painted shading, warm muted storybook palette and hand-drawn finish. References 2/3 support hand-drawn textbook quality only; do not copy their people. Reference 4 is thin line weight only, no robot elements. Canvas 908x680 px landscape, real transparent alpha. Exactly TWO full body copies of SAME character, centered in respective equal 454px halves. BOTH body and gaze turned slightly to viewer's RIGHT. Relaxed standing pose, full shoes visible aligned at bottom baseline, small top margin. LEFT expression: polite calm slightly sheepish asking for help with a small everyday inconvenience, gently concerned eyebrows, CLOSED mouth or very small gentle smile; NEVER sad, scared, distressed, or hands on face. RIGHT: warm happy smile because problem solved. CRITICAL: both copies have exactly identical pose, body, size, clothes, folds, hands, props, and line weight; ONLY eyebrows/eyes/mouth change, same face identity. Adult proportions match adults of sheet 1; child proportions about FIVE heads tall, not chibi. No text, letters, numbers, labels, divider, ground shadows, background, or extra objects. Hands relaxed at sides/in pockets/lightly together unless specified.
